visual.title: The boundary and the interior agree
visual.caption: The red loop is the boundary. The circulation around it is compared with the curl times the enclosed area, and the two numbers match because the curl is constant.

predict.question: Green's theorem relates the circulation to:
options: The double integral of the curl over the interior
The arc length of the boundary
predict.explain: ∮F·dr = ∬curl F dA. Here the circulation 2πr² equals the constant curl 2 times the area πr².
